title: Unit 19 Consolidation: Se in Notices, News and a Novel
goal: Review passive se, impersonal se and the other values of se, and read a short text about Vargas Llosa and La ciudad y los perros.
grammar: Review of passive se and impersonal se

items: I can make the verb agree with the noun after passive se, and keep it singular with no noun or with personal a.
I can leave out who did it with se, and name the doer with ser and por.
I can tell the five values of se apart.
I can read a short text about Vargas Llosa and La ciudad y los perros.
